AuthoredRevision.title: Authored revision
AuthoredRevision.description: Monotonic human-authored revision used for reviewed patch and stale-draft checks.

CargoRuleSchemaVersion.title: Cargo-rule schema
CargoRuleSchemaVersion.description: Unconditional cargo rules. Saved Load/Unload retain legacy market settlement; StationLoad/StationUnload transfer owned station stock, and OwnedCityLoad/OwnedCityUnload transfer home stock without settlement. Targets use stable owner and city identities; station actions require active RouteAccess and LocalStorage capabilities.

Connections.title: Reachable connections
Connections.description: Bidirectional city pairs and deterministic travel times available to this route family.

SourceCityId.description: Canonical City.* identity at one end of this reachable connection.

DestinationCityId.description: Canonical City.* identity at the other end of this bidirectional connection.

TravelTicks.description: Deterministic travel ticks for this connection before seasonal modifiers.

ContentHash.title: Content hash
ContentHash.description: Derived deterministic hash of accepted definition content; this value is never authored or proposed.

ContentSet.title: Content set
ContentSet.description: Stable content-set name controlling registry inclusion and fixture availability.

DefinitionCategory.title: Category
DefinitionCategory.description: Authoring category used for browsing and filtering; it does not define gameplay identity.

DisplayName.title: Display name
DisplayName.description: Localized display text shown to authors and players; it never defines stable identity.

LocalizationKey.title: Localization key
LocalizationKey.description: Stable localization identity for the display name.

Mode.title: Route mode
Mode.description: Sea or land network used by every connection.

PresentationMesh.title: Presentation mesh
PresentationMesh.description: Optional promoted mesh for this definition. Buildings require a mesh; non-spatial items may leave it empty. Stable identity never depends on this path.

ReplacementDefinitionId.title: Replacement definition ID
ReplacementDefinitionId.description: Canonical stable ID that replaces this definition when Deprecated is enabled.

SchemaVersion.title: Schema version
SchemaVersion.description: Version of this reflected definition schema. Breaking changes require an explicit migration.

StableDefinitionId.title: Stable definition ID
StableDefinitionId.description: Immutable canonical Domain.Name identity used by runtime registries, saves, references and authoring tools.

Tags.title: Tags
Tags.description: Deterministically sorted authoring and content-selection tags.

bDeprecated.title: Deprecated
bDeprecated.description: Marks this definition unavailable for new content while preserving compatibility for existing references.
